title: Senior Electrical Engineer
desc:
Who We Are?
Founded in 1993, Rönesans Holding operates today as a main contractor and investor across a wide geography spanning Türkiye, Europe, Central Asia, and Africa, with activities in construction, real estate, energy, industrial facilities, and healthcare.
With more than 40,000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world’s largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future.
What You’ll Do?
Prepare, review, and coordinate electrical designs, technical specifications, calculations, drawings, and material schedules.
Review single-line diagrams, equipment layouts, cable sizing, earthing systems, insulation coordination, and protection and control schemes.
Review overhead line designs, including conductor selection, electrical clearances, and interfaces with substations and civil works.
Coordinate technical interfaces between overhead lines, GIS, MV switchgear, transformers, cables, and auxiliary systems.
Ensure engineering deliverables comply with project specifications, applicable standards, and utility requirements.
Resolve technical queries, evaluate proposed deviations, and document engineering decisions.
Prepare technical requisitions and specifications for electrical equipment and materials.
Evaluate suppliers’ technical proposals and prepare technical bid evaluations.
Review vendor drawings, calculations, data sheets, and compliance submissions.
Coordinate technical clarifications with suppliers and support the procurement team in resolving equipment-related issues.
Participate in factory acceptance tests and review inspection and test reports.
Track vendor documentation and technical approvals against procurement and delivery schedules.
Provide technical guidance to site teams and electrical subcontractors.
Review installation drawings, method statements, inspection and test plans, and material submissions.
Verify that electrical installations comply with approved designs, specifications, and quality requirements.
Resolve site engineering issues and coordinate design changes with relevant parties.
Identify technical nonconformities and follow up on corrective actions.
Coordinate electrical work interfaces with civil, mechanical, and other project disciplines.
Act as the primary technical contact for electrical engineering matters within the assigned scope.
Coordinate technical submissions and responses to comments from clients, consultants, utilities, and government authorities.
Attend technical meetings and support permit, approval, inspection, and connection processes.
Track outstanding technical approvals and escalate issues affecting project delivery to the Project Manager.
Maintain clear records of technical correspondence, approvals, and agreed actions.
Review testing and commissioning procedures for electrical equipment and systems.
Support site acceptance tests, protection testing, interlock checks, and functional verification.
Coordinate technical readiness for energization with the commissioning team, utilities, and relevant authorities.
Review test results, support defect resolution, and verify completion of outstanding technical items.
Review as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and final handover documentation.
Monitor engineering deliverables and technical approvals against the project schedule.
Identify technical risks and recommend practical solutions.
Assess the technical impact of proposed changes and provide input on cost and schedule implications.
Report engineering progress, outstanding decisions, and technical issues to the Project Manager.
Guide junior engineers and promote consistent engineering and documentation practices.
What We Expect from You?
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5-10 years of electrical engineering experience in power infrastructure projects, including overhead lines, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), and medium-voltage (MV) switchgear systems.
Proven experience in a senior engineering role involving design coordination, procurement support, and site execution.
Strong knowledge of power systems, equipment selection, protection and control, earthing, and electrical installation practices.
Experience reviewing engineering designs, vendor documentation, and technical procurement submissions.
Practical experience in construction support, testing, commissioning, and energization activities.
Experience coordinating with utilities, government authorities, consultants, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Familiarity with applicable IEC/IEEE standards, local regulations, and utility requirements.
Proficiency in electrical engineering and drawing tools; experience with power system analysis software such as ETAP or DIgSILENT is an advantage.
Professional engineering registration is an advantage.
Strong technical judgment and attention to detail.
Practical problem-solving and sound decision-making.
Clear communication and effective stakeholder coordination.
Ability to manage multiple engineering interfaces and deadlines.
Commitment to safety, quality, and reliable system operation.
Ability to mentor engineers and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
What We Offer?
Performance-based bonus practices that recognize and reward success
Comprehensive benefits and employee support programs
Private Health Insurance benefits designed to support employee health and well-being
Training and development programs that foster professional and personal growth
Our Diversity and Equality Statement
Rönesans Holding is among the signatories of the United Nations Global Compact, which calls on companies to align their strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment and anti-corruption, and to take actions that advance societal goals. Rönesans Holding adopts the universally accepted principles based on the declarations recognized within the framework of the United Nations Global Compact.
Rönesans Holding is an employer that aims to ensure equality in its human resources practices by upholding transparent and ethical values, without compromising its core principles of integrity, competitiveness and innovation.
All applications are evaluated based on equal opportunity, regardless of gender, language, religion, race or ethnic origin, and no discrimination is applied.
